paragraphs.zh: 本发明的有益效果在于:通过改进工艺,缩短了反应步骤和时间,提高了中间体2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的收率;该工艺采用甲磺酰氯替代甲硫醚的氯取代反应,革除了硫醚的过氧化氢氧化步骤,使反应条件更温和,生产工艺更安全;在2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯中间体的制备过程中,使用溴素代替昂贵的NBS进行侧链甲基的溴化,使得生产成本降低。
paragraphs.en: The beneficial effects of the present invention are: by improving the process, the reaction steps and time are shortened, and the yield of the intermediate methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate is raised; this process uses methanesulfonyl chloride in place of the chloro-substitution reaction of the methyl sulfide, doing away with the hydrogen-peroxide oxidation step of the thioether, which makes the reaction conditions milder and the production process safer; in the preparation of the methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate intermediate, bromine is used in place of expensive NBS to brominate the side-chain methyl group, which lowers the production cost.
paragraphs.notes: The clause 该工艺采用甲磺酰氯替代甲硫醚的氯取代反应 is chemically ambiguous as written and has been translated literally. It can be read either as (a) methanesulfonyl chloride replaces the chloro-displacement reaction that forms the methyl sulfide, or (b) methanesulfonyl chloride replaces the methyl sulfide in a chloro-substitution reaction. Reading (a) is the one consistent with Example 1 at [0035], where 2-chlorotoluene is sulfonylated directly with CH3SO2Cl/AlCl3 and no thioether is ever formed. Punctuation: the compact comma/semicolon/colon glyphs are transcribed here as half-width , ; : because that is how they are printed in this scan; they may correspond to full-width ，；： in the source text. The sentence-final 。 and the enumeration comma 、 are unambiguously full-width.
Unnumbered bold section heading printed between [0031] and [0032]. Recorded here so its position is recoverable; it carries no paragraph marker.

paragraphs.zh: 下面结合实施例对本发明做进一步详细的说明,但是此说明不会构成对本发明的限制。实施例1
paragraphs.en: The present invention is further described in detail below in conjunction with the examples, but this description shall not constitute a limitation of the present invention. Example 1
paragraphs.notes: 实施例1 (Example 1) is printed on the same line, immediately after the sentence-final 。, and is set inside paragraph [0032] rather than given its own marker.

The leading 1、 is the step number within Example 1, not part of the compound name. Do not misread 1、2- as the locant pair 1,2-; the mark after the 1 is the full-width ideographic comma 、 and the compound is 2-chloro-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene.
Marker only. The paragraph body is a single centred structural drawing (see drawings entry with between_markers [0034],[0035]); no text follows the marker on this line.

paragraphs.zh: 在装有搅拌器,温度计和回流冷凝管的500ml四口反应瓶中加入2-氯甲苯25.3g(0.2mol)、无水三氯化铝40.5g(0.3mol)和1,2-二氯乙烷150ml,冷却至5℃,然后滴加甲磺酰氯25.25g(0.22mol),滴加温度不超过10℃,滴加完毕,升至室温继续反应10h,LC跟踪（液相色谱）至反应完全,将反应物倾入冰水中,分出有机层,水层用1,2-二氯甲烷萃取,合并有机相,浓缩得淡黄的固体28.6g,收率84％。
paragraphs.en: Into a 500 ml four-necked reaction flask fitted with a stirrer, a thermometer and a reflux condenser were charged 2-chlorotoluene 25.3 g (0.2 mol), anhydrous aluminium trichloride 40.5 g (0.3 mol) and 1,2-dichloroethane 150 ml; cooled to 5 degrees C, then methanesulfonyl chloride 25.25 g (0.22 mol) was added dropwise, the addition temperature not exceeding 10 degrees C; after the addition was complete the mixture was warmed to room temperature and the reaction continued for 10 h, followed by LC (liquid chromatography) until the reaction was complete; the reaction mixture was poured into ice water, the organic layer was separated, the aqueous layer was extracted with 1,2-dichloromethane, the organic phases were combined and concentrated to give a pale yellow solid 28.6 g, yield 84%.
paragraphs.notes: Transcribed verbatim including what appears to be an error in the patent: the extraction solvent is written 1,2-二氯甲烷 ('1,2-dichloromethane'), which is not a real compound - dichloromethane has no locants. The charged solvent earlier in the same sentence is written correctly as 1,2-二氯乙烷 (1,2-dichloroethane). Not corrected here. The parentheses around 液相色谱 are printed full-width （）whereas those around the molar quantities are half-width ( ). ℃ and ％ are the full-width forms as printed. Yield mass 28.6 g at 84% corresponds to the sulfone product of MW ~188.6 from 0.2 mol 2-chlorotoluene.

structures.core: benzene ester of cyclohex-2-en-1-one (enol ester); benzoate ring plus a 3-oxocyclohex-1-en-1-yl ring joined through the ester oxygen
substituents: on the carbocycle: ketone C=O drawn at the ring carbon two bonds from the ester-bearing carbon, with the C=C drawn between the ester-bearing carbon and the CH between it and the ketone
structures.name: 3-oxocyclohex-1-en-1-yl 2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoate

structures.core: cyclohexane-1,3-dione bearing an aroyl group at C2, joined to a benzene ring
substituents: aroyl C(=O)Ar at C2 of the cyclohexane-1,3-dione
on the benzene ring: C(=O) linkage at C1
structures.name: 2-{2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl}cyclohexane-1,3-dione (tembotrione)

arrows.note: Sodium methanethiolate displaces one of the two chlorines. Nothing is written below this arrow.
Friedel-Crafts acetylation. Above and below are distinct: CH3COCl sits above the arrow line, AlCl3 below it.

SCHEMA DEVIATION, DELIBERATE: arrow_style is 'none_drawn' because there is physically no arrow here. Row 1 ends with the 3rd structure at the right margin and row 2 begins with the 4th structure at the left margin. The two structures differ - SCH3 at C4 becomes SO2CH3 at C4 - so a real chemical transformation (sulfide to sulfone oxidation) occurs across the line wrap with no arrow and no reagent drawn anywhere on the page. Verified by cropping and enlarging the right edge of row 1 and the left edge of row 2. Recorded as an arrow so the connectivity of the scheme is not lost.
Haloform oxidation of the methyl ketone to the carboxylic acid. Nothing below the arrow.
Fischer esterification to the methyl ester. No acid catalyst is written above or below.

Benzylic bromination of the C3 methyl. The arrow and its Br2 label are at the far left of row 3, i.e. this arrow wraps: its starting structure (6th) is at the far right of row 2 and its product (7th) is in row 3. Nothing below the arrow.

Sodium 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxide displaces the benzylic bromide. The drawn product is the free carboxylic acid, not the methyl ester, so ester hydrolysis also happens across this single arrow with no hydrolysis reagent written above or below.

SCHEMA DEVIATION, DELIBERATE: second line wrap with no arrow. Row 3 ends with the 8th structure (free acid) at the right margin and row 4 begins with the 9th structure (the 3-oxocyclohex-1-en-1-yl enol ester) at the left margin. The esterification of the acid with cyclohexane-1,3-dione is therefore implied but no arrow, coupling agent or base is drawn. Verified by cropping and enlarging the right edge of row 3.

reagents_above: acetone cyanohydrin, drawn as a structure rather than written as a formula: a quaternary carbon bearing CN drawn upward, OH drawn to the lower right, and two methyl bonds drawn as plain lines to the left and upper right, i.e. (CH3)2C(CN)OH
arrows.note: Fries-type rearrangement of the enol ester to the C-acylated 1,3-dione. Above and below are distinct: the acetone cyanohydrin structure sits above the arrow line, Et3N below it. The reagent above is a drawing, not text - a text OCR pass would return only the orphan fragments 'CN' and 'OH' here.

drawings.notes: Large multi-step scheme occupying the top two-thirds of the page, running from the page top (it has no caption or introducing text on this page; whatever introduces it is on p05) down to paragraph [0031]. It is laid out as four rows read left to right, top to bottom, with two silent line wraps between rows 1/2 and rows 3/4 where a chemical change occurs but no arrow is drawn. Ten structures, seven drawn arrows, two undrawn wrap transformations. ATTRIBUTION: see discrepancies - the drawn route conflicts with both [0031] and Example 1 and cannot be resolved as the invention's route or as prior art from this page alone. All ring positions above were read off the drawing vertex by vertex, not inferred from the expected identity of the compounds. The target of the whole scheme is tembotrione.

The product of Example 1 step 1. Drawn as a hexagon with a flat vertical left edge: Cl on the upper-right vertex drawn straight up, CH3 on the right-middle vertex drawn up-and-right, SO2CH3 on the lower-right vertex drawn down-and-right, three unsubstituted vertices on the left. This matches the name given in [0033] (2-氯-6-甲磺酰基甲苯). Note the skeleton is identical to the 2nd structure of the big scheme except that SO2CH3 replaces SCH3 - this is the substitution the invention claims as its improvement.

discrepancies.what: The first step of the drawn scheme is exactly the transformation that [0031] says the invention does away with.
discrepancies.drawing_says: 2,6-dichlorotoluene + CH3SNa gives the aryl methyl sulfide 2-chloro-6-(methylsulfanyl)toluene.
discrepancies.text_says: [0031]: 该工艺采用甲磺酰氯替代甲硫醚的氯取代反应 - the process uses methanesulfonyl chloride in place of the chloro-substitution reaction of the methyl sulfide.

discrepancies.what: The scheme contains a sulfide-to-sulfone oxidation, which [0031] says the invention eliminates, and it is drawn with no arrow and no reagent at all.
discrepancies.drawing_says: SCH3 at C4 in the 3rd structure silently becomes SO2CH3 at C4 in the 4th structure across the row 1 / row 2 line wrap. No arrow, no oxidant.
discrepancies.text_says: [0031]: 革除了硫醚的过氧化氢氧化步骤 - did away with the hydrogen-peroxide oxidation step of the thioether.

discrepancies.what: The compound and the step that Example 1 actually performs appear nowhere in the drawn scheme.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The scheme never contains 2-chloro-6-(methanesulfonyl)toluene and never contains a CH3SO2Cl/AlCl3 step; its starting material is 2,6-dichlorotoluene.
discrepancies.text_says: [0033]-[0035]: Example 1 step 1 makes 2-chloro-6-methanesulfonyltoluene from 2-chlorotoluene (25.3 g, 0.2 mol), AlCl3 (40.5 g, 0.3 mol) and methanesulfonyl chloride (25.25 g, 0.22 mol) in 1,2-dichloroethane, 84% yield. 2,6-dichlorotoluene never appears in the example.

discrepancies.what: One point where the drawing agrees with the invention rather than with the prior art, which is why the attribution cannot be settled cleanly.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Benzylic bromination of the C3 methyl uses Br2.
discrepancies.text_says: [0031]: 使用溴素代替昂贵的NBS进行侧链甲基的溴化 - bromine is used in place of expensive NBS for the side-chain methyl bromination, presented as an improvement of the invention over the prior art.

discrepancies.what: A single drawn arrow performs two transformations but only one reagent is written on it.
discrepancies.drawing_says: CF3CH2ONa over the arrow converts the methyl ester bearing a benzylic bromide into the free carboxylic acid bearing CH2OCH2CF3. The ester hydrolysis has no reagent above or below the arrow.
discrepancies.text_says: Nothing on this page describes this step; no hydrolysis reagent is named in the page text.

discrepancies.what: The enol-ester formation is present in the scheme but has no arrow and no reagent.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The free benzoic acid at the end of row 3 appears at the start of row 4 as its 3-oxocyclohex-1-en-1-yl enol ester. No arrow, no cyclohexane-1,3-dione, no coupling agent drawn.
discrepancies.text_says: Nothing on this page describes this step.

discrepancies.what: Apparent typographical error inside [0035], transcribed verbatim and not corrected.
discrepancies.text_says: [0035] charges 1,2-二氯乙烷 (1,2-dichloroethane) as solvent but names the extraction solvent 1,2-二氯甲烷 ('1,2-dichloromethane'), which is not a real compound.
